ADDENDUM (Decree on the Strategic Command) <Presidential Decree No. 34789, August 6, 2024>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on October 1, 2024.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (3) Omitted.
(4) Part of the Decree on the Organization of the Joint Chiefs of Staff shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3 (3), "Strategic Planning Headquarters, Military Support Headquarters, and Nuclear and Weapons of Mass Destruction Response Headquarters" shall be replaced with "Strategic Planning Headquarters and Military Support Headquarters."
Article 11-2 shall be deleted.
